# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Avonlea school  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Phillips is a schoolmaster who curls his mustache and makes eyes at his older student, Prissy Andrews. When teaching, he occasionally uses sarcasm that flickers in his tone and wears an expression that can turn stern and glaring.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065)_

## Personality

Mr. Phillips exhibits spasmodic fits of reform regarding school discipline and carries out his authority with a high hand. He is sarcastic, unjust, and prone to using scapegoats to save his word rather than punishing all guilty parties equally. He neglects his younger pupils to devote his time to those preparing for advanced examinations.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## Goals

- Preparing his advanced students for the entrance examination into Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Courting Prissy Andrews  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster of Avonlea school, where he notoriously paid more attention to his student Prissy Andrews than to his general teaching duties. During his tenure, he humiliated Anne Shirley by publicly shaming her temper after she broke a slate over Gilbert Blythe's head, and later punished her for tardiness by forcing her to sit next to Gilbert. Following this incident, Anne refused to attend school under his instruction for several weeks. At the end of the school term, Mr. Phillips delivered an affecting farewell speech to his pupils before leaving Avonlea, a departure that was facilitated by his uncle's influence on the school board.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P73](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0073), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Boarded at the house of Eben Wright while teaching in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- Secured his teaching position through his uncle, who was a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
